# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` in the repository root. It is the single source of rules for every agent here.

When reviewing pull requests:

- Flag any secret, credential, key or `.env` content as a blocking issue.
- Check that the change matches the pull request description and that tests cover it.
- Offer at least one alternative approach when you see one, and explain the trade-off.
- Point out claims in the description or docs that the change does not support.
- Use Australian English spelling in suggested text.
